events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktree state and origin/main drift
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git status --short | head -20 && git log --oneline -3 && git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main | wc -l && tail -5 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-200; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: List worktrees and check remote branch
events.input: $ git worktree list | head; git fetch -q origin; git log --oneline -3 origin/t300-ruled-out-cleanup; git log --oneline origin/t300-ruled-out-cleanup..origin/main | wc -l

events.name: Bash
events.head: Recreate worktree and merge origin/main
events.input: $ git worktree prune && git worktree add -q /private/tmp/wt-t300 t300-ruled-out-cleanup 2>&1 | tail -2; cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git log --oneline -1 && git merge --no-edit origin/main 2>&1 | tail -5; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect merge conflicts
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git diff app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs | head -60; git diff --stat app/src/generated/playbook/content.ts | tail -1; grep -rn "playbook/content.ts\|content.ts" app/package.json app/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check conflict counts and generator
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && grep -c "^<<<<<<<" app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs; git diff app/src/generated/playbook/content.ts | head -30; grep -rln "generated/playbook" app/scripts | head

events.text: Recreated the vanished worktree and am merging origin/main; resolving two conflicts now.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Resolve probe conflict, find playbook generator

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find playbook content generator
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && head -5 app/src/generated/playbook/content.ts | cut -c1-200 | grep -v "^ \"" ; grep -rln "PLAYBOOK_PARTS\b" --include=*.py --include=*.mjs --include=*.js . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head

events.text: Playbook.html auto-merged; regenerate content.ts from it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Regenerate playbook content from merged HTML
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git checkout --theirs app/src/generated/playbook/content.ts && python3 workshop-plan/build/embed.py 2>&1 | tail -3; grep -c "<<<<<<<" app/src/generated/playbook/content.ts workshop-plan/playbook.html; git status --short | grep -v "^M " | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit merge and rerun done_when grep
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git add app/scripts/probe-domain-chain.mjs app/src/generated/playbook/content.ts && git status --short | grep -v "^[MADR] " | head; git commit -q --no-edit && git log --oneline -1; for n in godaddy "microsoft 365" m365 instantly sendgrid zerobounce neverbounce builtwith heyreach calendly apollo; do echo "$n: $(git grep -il "$n" -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/survey.html | grep -v examples/data | tr '\n' ' ')"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check deps and read run-chain header
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && ls -d app/node_modules cloud/node_modules 2>&1; sed -n 1,40p app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find lane stack scripts
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && ls app/scripts cloud/scripts | grep -iE "lane|stack|local|dev" ; grep -rn "CHAIN_ADMIN" --include=*.sh --include=*.md -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check previous logs and launchd stack
events.input: $ ls /tmp/chain-t300 /tmp/t300-chain.log 2>&1 | head; ls -dt /tmp/chain* 2>/dev/null | head -5; launchctl list 2>/dev/null | grep -i tantra | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect run-dev and launchd centre config
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh | head -30; plutil -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.revops-centre-dev.plist 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "dir|args|sh" | head

events.text: Setting up a private centre built from the branch (the shared :8790 one serves another checkout), plus a clean origin/main baseline.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check dev vars link, sim port, chain env
events.input: $ ls -l /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2/cloud/.dev.vars /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/.dev.vars 2>&1 | awk '{print $1,$9,$10,$11}'; cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && grep -nE "PORT|argv|environ" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8; grep -nE "RUNNER|8791|8792" cloud/wrangler.jsonc | head; grep -n "CHAIN_SIM_RESET\|SIM_URL\|FUNNEL_URL" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head
